newsitem.title: USA: SOCCER-GOODWILL GAMES ADD SOCCER, WRESTLING, WATER POLO.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-GOODWILL GAMES ADD SOCCER, WRESTLING, WATER POLO.

text.p: The Goodwill Games are adding soccer to their multi-sport programme for the first time and have reinstated wrestling and water polo for the July 19-August 2 competition here next year, organisers said Wednesday.
Along with the additions, came the subtraction of indoor volleyball from the programme, which organisers said was cut because of venue problems and scheduling conflicts.

The 1998 Games will now feature competition in 15 sports with 1,300 athletes from more than 60 countries expected to participate with $5 million in prize money and world record/performance incentives on offer.
